# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 to 14 years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Crow  <sub>[v1 c15 P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty little girl with rosy cheeks, bright black eyes, and glossy black hair. She is shorter and rounder than Anne, possessing dimples on her face. She takes care with her attire, often dressing in stylish coats, caps, and dresses.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c19 P35](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0035), [v1 c25 P40](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0040), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, and amiable, inheriting a merry expression from her father. She laughs frequently before speaking and enjoys reading, poring over books whenever possible. Though practical and conventional in many ways, she warmly appreciates romance, stories, and imaginative pastimes.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c17 P11](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0011), [v1 c26 P16](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0016)_

## History

After returning from a visit to Carmody, Diana met Anne Shirley and the two swore a solemn oath of eternal friendship. They established a playhouse named Idlewild, formed a story club, and spent their days playing together. When Anne accidentally served her currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, Diana became intoxicated, prompting her mother to forbid them from interacting. After Diana ran to Green Gables for help when her little sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup, Anne saved the child's life, leading Mrs. Barry to forgive Anne and allow the girls to resume their friendship. Later, during a sleepover at Diana's house, the girls accidentally leaped into a bed occupied by visiting Aunt Josephine Barry, though Anne managed to soothe the old lady's anger. As they grew older, Diana and Anne attended concerts, traveled to Charlottetown for the Exhibition, and enjoyed summer days boating on the pond.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P20](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0020), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c18 P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v1 c29 P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 c29 P22](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0022)_

- Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear,  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
